title: 第9章 阵破第10章 逃离
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
这时，卫君雨抬手示意大家安静，见人群中声音逐渐变小后，说道：
“我这里有一些黄山剑宗外门制式法器飞剑，和一些符篆提供给各位。没有武器的人，可以来我这领取一把飞剑和几张符篆。”
说着一拍储物袋，数百把飞剑法器散落到地上。虽然都是下品法器，但也可以看出黄山剑宗的财大气粗。
现场聚集了将近三百位矿工，大部分都是炼气初期的，只有很少几个炼气中期的，炼气后期的更是一个没有。
看着地上的法器，周围声音又变得嘈杂起来。很多人都已是面色苍白，甚至有些人已经微微有些颤抖起来。
“我们为黄山剑宗采矿，黄山剑宗就要保证我们的安全！”这时有人喊道。
“是啊是啊，我们只是普通散修，都没战斗的经验。”
“黄山剑宗要负责!”
人群中很多人都附和着。
“我理解大家的心情......”卫君雨正要继续安抚。
这时，一位手持重剑的修士拉住卫君雨：“卫师兄，不用和他们解释那么多。”
说完他朝众人喊道：“诸位莫不是在世俗、在坊市待久了？这可是修仙界，修炼从来不是风平浪静，一帆风顺！”
“在进入百万大山的时候，你们就要时刻做好自卫的准备。没有人会永远保护你们！也没有人永远做你们的奶妈！”
众人听到这位修士的话，微微愣了一下。他们大部分都是初阶修士，确实一直生活在和平的人类疆域，大部分都没有到过百万大山。
秦怀安也并不怎么了解百万大山，原主只是在百万大山边缘采过一些常见的灵药，而这赤铜矿要更深入一些。
“钟师弟，他们大部分毕竟还都是炼气初期。”卫君雨说道。
“卫师兄，都什么时候，我等这次也不一定能安全逃脱，多一个人多一份力量。没有斗志，他们死的更惨！”
卫君雨默然，不再继续阻拦。
钟姓修士继续说道：
“修行本就是要争，争机缘、争资源。来百万大山采矿，也是为了资源，百万大山是妖兽的主场，既然来了，就要有被妖兽攻击的觉悟。”

“而现在，妖兽已经攻过来了，就不要在这怨天尤人，拿起武器来和它们干就完了！”
“睁开眼睛看看这漫山遍野的妖兽，我等也是自身难保，你们觉得谁能保护你们呢？！”
“言尽于此，愿意抵抗的、不想坐以待毙的就拿起武器来！”
人群顿时沉默了下来。这时一个面相威猛的大汉向前一步，拿起一把飞剑。
秦怀安看到这人正是姜渊。秦怀安也向前一步，拿起了一个把飞剑，虽不会剑法，但有武器总比没有强。
越来越多的人上前取过飞剑。这时，小胖子看到了秦怀安，悄悄走到他身旁。
“秦兄，一会儿我们相会照应一下。”
秦怀安默默点了点头，他和小胖子也算是熟人，乱阵之中相互有个照应也不错。
content_en:
At this time, Wei Junyu raised his hand to signal everyone to be quiet. Seeing that the voices in the crowd gradually became quieter, he said:
"I have some standard flying swords from the outer sect of the Huangshan Sword Sect and some talismans here for you. Those who don't have weapons can come to me to get a flying sword and a few talismans."
As he spoke, he patted the storage bag, and hundreds of flying sword weapons scattered to the ground. Although they are all low-grade magical weapons, it can also be seen that the Huangshan Sword Sect is wealthy.
Nearly three hundred miners gathered at the scene, most of them were in the early stage of Qi refining, only a few were in the middle stage of Qi refining, and even none were in the late stage of Qi refining.
Looking at the magic weapon on the ground, the surrounding sounds became noisy again. Many people were pale, and some were even trembling slightly.
"We mine for the Huangshan Sword Sect, and the Huangshan Sword Sect must ensure our safety!" someone shouted at this time.
"Yes, yes, we are just ordinary cultivators and have no combat experience."
"Huangshan Sword Sect is responsible!"
Many in the crowd echoed.
"I understand everyone's mood..." Wei Junyu was about to continue to comfort.
At this time, a monk holding a heavy sword pulled Wei Junyu and said, "Senior Brother Wei, there is no need to explain so much to them."
After speaking, he shouted to everyone: "Have you been in the secular world and in the city for a long time? This is the world of cultivation, and cultivation is never calm and smooth!"
"When entering the Million Mountains, you must always be prepared to defend yourself. No one will protect you forever! And no one will be your wet nurse forever!"
Everyone was slightly stunned when they heard what the monk said. Most of them are junior monks, and they have indeed been living in peaceful human territories. Most of them have never been to the Million Mountains.
Qin Huaian didn't know much about Million Mountain. The original owner had only mined some common elixirs on the edge of Million Mountain, and this copper mine was deeper.
"Junior Brother Zhong, most of them are still in the early stages of Qi refining after all." Wei Junyu said.
"Senior Brother Wei, no matter what time, I may not be able to escape safely this time. One more person will bring more strength. Without fighting spirit, they will die even worse!"
Wei Junyu remained silent and stopped blocking her.
The monk surnamed Zhong continued:
"Cultivation is all about competing for opportunities and resources. You come to Mining Mountain to mine for resources. Million Mountain is the home of monsters. Since you are here, you must be aware of being attacked by monsters."
"And now, the monsters have attacked, so don't blame others here, just pick up weapons and fight them!"
"Open your eyes and look at the monsters all over the mountains and plains. We can't protect ourselves. Who do you think can protect you?!"
"With that said, those who are willing to resist and don't want to sit back and wait to be killed should take up arms!"
The crowd suddenly fell silent. At this time, a strong-looking man stepped forward and picked up a flying sword.
Qin Huaian saw that this person was Jiang Yuan. Qin Huaian also took a step forward and picked up flying swords. Although he didn't know swordsmanship, having weapons was better than nothing.
More and more people came forward to take the flying sword. At this time, the little fat man saw Qin Huaian and quietly walked to him.
"Brother Qin, we will meet and take care of you later."
Qin Huaian nodded silently. He and the little fat man were acquaintances, so it would be good to have each other looking after each other in the chaos.
